policy: Every embedded image or other media asset included in the formal 32-chapter report must have an explicit rights/provenance record. Third-party assets are recorded in `assets`. Report-authored figures are recorded in `first_party_assets`, with the source identity of the data they render. The report embeds no third-party raster/vector figures; source data are presented as report-authored tables and figures with citations.

last_rights_review.long_blockquotes_reviewed: Markdown blockquotes over 25 words were reviewed as report-authored analytical callouts/mechanism summaries rather than reproduced third-party prose.
last_rights_review.first_party_figure_set_reviewed: The 11-figure core set added in 6b1422d (2026-09-03) was reviewed on 2026-09-14. Every figure is an original report-authored SVG schematic; the two data-bearing figures (3 and 4) and figure 7 render cited first-party disclosures rather than reproducing third-party artwork. Figure-level provenance is recorded in en/publication/figures/README.md.

prior_review.result: No embedded third-party media identified in the report as of the August 28, 2026 freeze.

last_rights_review.result: No embedded third-party media identified. All embedded assets are report-authored.
last_rights_review.boundary: Any future embedded third-party image, figure, iframe, or long reproduced quotation requires a fresh rights/provenance review before it is included in the formal report. A report-authored figure that renders a third-party chart or photograph, rather than a first-party disclosure of values, is third-party media and is not covered by this record.
